evidence_boundaries: The LUXE detector paper reports ARES and FACET-II prototype beam tests, not completed LUXE collision spectra.
The vacuum-diode attenuation data are experimental, while the 24-25 percent anomalous-energy fraction is an AI-assisted Fredholm inversion.
The vector-vortex gamma paper is a conditional strong-field-QED mode calculation without a gamma-beam experiment or yield budget.
The EXL-50U MPC results are nonlinear FGE closed-loop simulations and controller-process timings, not device shots or full-loop latency.
No Ptarmigan/Geant4, Fredholm inversion, strong-field-QED amplitude, MEQ/FGE or OSQP calculation was rerun locally.
